_comment: OpenSSF Best Practices (Passing) self-assessment for Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo. Open https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/13989/passing/edit and use Save (and continue) with the robot to import. Review each highlighted Met/N/A before accepting.
name: dumpers_repo
description: Dumper's Repo — Star Citizen blueprint tracking, mining tools, resource coordination, member marketplace, and Dumper Apps (BP Dumper).
description_good_justification: https://www.dumpers-repo.com and README describe Dumper's Repo: Star Citizen blueprint tracking, mining tools, resource coordination, and a member marketplace.
interact_justification: Obtain: site + GitHub Releases (Dumper Apps). Feedback: GitHub Issues and in-app Support. Contribute: open a pull request against main (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md — lint/test/build, theme tokens, no secrets, dumper commit scope. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, and in-app Information Archive.
documentation_interface_justification: README site map / features document the web UI; BP Dumper docs + docs/SUPABASE_SETUP.md document the dumper/API webhook interface (Authorization: Bearer dr_…).
sites_https_justification: Project website, GitHub repository, and GitHub Releases download URLs use HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests; in-app Support for members.
english_justification: Documentation, UI, and issue/PR discussion are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; recent commits, PRs, and Dumper Apps releases on GitHub.
repo_track_justification: Git on GitHub tracks who changed what and when.
repo_interim_justification: Full git history with ongoing commits/PRs between releases.
version_unique_justification: Dumper Apps releases use unique SemVer tags (vX.Y.Z) via semantic-release / GitHub Releases.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning for Dumper Apps tags (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
release_notes_justification: Human-readable notes on GitHub Releases + scripts/bp-dumper/CHANGELOG.md. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known CVE-assigned run-time vulnerabilities fixed in releases to date.
test_justification: npm test (unit + mining math) documented in CONTRIBUTING + README; CI runs it. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
delivery_mitm_justification: Site, repository, and GitHub Releases are HTTPS-only.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Credentials live in GitHub Actions secrets and local .env (gitignored). Repo does not commit API keys or service credentials; see SECURITY.md and .gitignore.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues: https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/issues — also in-app Support on dumpers-repo.com for members.
report_responses_justification: Bug reports via GitHub Issues and in-app Support are acknowledged (triaged) by the maintainer; a majority of reports in the active window receive a response even when a fix is not immediate.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests on GitHub Issues / Support receive a triage response for a majority of requests in the active window.
report_archive_justification: Public archive: https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/issues (searchable GitHub Issues + PR discussions).
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md requires private reporting (maintainer email or in-app Support marked security) — not public GitHub issues for exploitable findings. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: N/A — no private vulnerability reports received in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledge within 7 days (<=14 days) when reports arrive.
build_justification: Working build: npm ci && npm run build (Vite). Documented in README/CONTRIBUTING; CI builds every PR. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
build_common_tools_justification: Node.js / npm / Vite are standard tools for this stack. Dumper Apps Windows packaging uses documented PowerShell + Inno Setup in CI.
build_floss_tools_justification: Site build uses FLOSS toolchain (Node, npm, Vite, TypeScript, ESLint). Python portions use CPython.
test_most_justification: SUGGESTED: automated suite covers mining math and selected unit helpers; it does not yet cover most SPA branches/UI paths.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent major quality work added npm test (scripts/tests/ + verify-mining-math) and wired it into CI (lint -> test -> build) per CONTRIBUTING policy.
warnings_justification: ESLint (npm run lint) on TypeScript/React sources; CI fails the PR if lint fails. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint findings are addressed so main stays green; required CI check lint-and-build blocks merge when ESLint fails.
warnings_strict_justification: CI treats ESLint failures as hard errors (merge blocked).
know_secure_design_justification: Primary developer designs with least privilege and defense-in-depth: browser uses anon key only; marketplace/order mutations go through checked SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (not client INSERT/UPDATE); privileged profile columns and Discord queue EXECUTE are locked down; Edge Functions keep service_role server-side. See SECURITY.md and repo security patterns.
know_common_errors_justification: Primary developer is familiar with common web/app vulnerabilities for this stack (XSS, authz bypass, injection, secret leakage) and mitigations used here: React escaping, Supabase RLS + SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, least-privilege anon key, secrets only in Actions/.env, CodeQL on PRs.
crypto_published_justification: No custom cryptography. Transport security uses published TLS via browsers, hosting (HTTPS), and Supabase. Client randomness uses Web Crypto (crypto.randomUUID) where needed.
crypto_call_justification: Cryptographic work is delegated to platform libraries (browser TLS/Web Crypto, Supabase Auth / hosting TLS). The project does not re-implement ciphers.
crypto_floss_justification: TLS and Web Crypto in browsers/OS and FLOSS server stacks implement the crypto the app depends on.
crypto_keylength_justification: N/A — this project does not configure TLS keylengths or generate long-term asymmetric keys; it relies on browser/hosting defaults that meet modern TLS requirements.
crypto_working_justification: No application code depends on broken algorithms (MD5/DES/RC4/etc.) for security. Auth and transport use platform TLS and Supabase Auth.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Defaults do not rely on SHA-1/CBC-era primitives for security mechanisms; HTTPS/TLS is provided by modern hosting and browsers.
crypto_pfs_justification: N/A — the project does not implement its own key-agreement protocols; PFS is provided by the TLS stacks of the browser and hosting providers.
crypto_password_storage_justification: N/A — member passwords are handled by Supabase Auth (GoTrue), not stored as password hashes in this repository's application code.
crypto_random_justification: Where the client needs identifiers/nonces, it uses cryptographically secure Web Crypto (e.g. crypto.randomUUID), not Math.random, for security-sensitive values.
delivery_unsigned_justification: We do not retrieve cryptographic hashes over plain HTTP for integrity checks. Site assets and GitHub Releases are served over HTTPS. (Authenticode signing via SignPath is in progress separately.)
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No medium-or-higher severity publicly known vulnerabilities in project results have remained unpatched for more than 60 days. Dependency alerts are monitored via GitHub/Dependabot and CodeQL.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Critical issues are prioritized for rapid fix after confirmation; none are left open as known critical unpatched issues in project results.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL runs on push/PR for javascript-typescript, python, and actions. https://github.com/Sinedrone-Sentinel/dumpers_repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: GitHub CodeQL security query suites look for common vulnerabilities in JS/TS, Python, and Actions workflows.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Medium+ exploitable CodeQL findings are fixed or dismissed with justification in a timely way; code scanning keeps the bar on main.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL on every push to main and every PR, plus weekly schedule.
dynamic_analysis_justification: SUGGESTED: no routine fuzzer or DAST applied to every major release yet.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: N/A — project results are primarily TypeScript/JavaScript and Python (memory-safe managed languages), not C/C++.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: SUGGESTED: no dedicated dynamic-analysis configuration with assertion-heavy modes yet.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: N/A — no medium+ vulnerabilities discovered via project dynamic analysis to fix (dynamic analysis not yet routinely applied).
